synopsis: That day, when I met you, my world, where I couldn't even speak, was filled with music. High school student Fujieda Yuzuki is a kind girl who is liked by everyone. She prioritizes the people around her - her friends and her boyfriend - and hides her true feelings. She's not good at using her own voice. Putting others first had been Yuzuki's way of life up until then. That is, until she met you. One day, Yuzuki comes across a girl singing and playing the guitar on the street. Unable to forget the voice, she was humming a tune alone in the classroom after school when the girl from that time, Terada Hinata, appeared. It turned out to be a student at the same high school. What's more, she spoke to him, saying, "I've come from the future to save you" --!? A girl meets girl x school youth story!! (Source: Young Ace Up, translated)

synopsis: Every girl Rui crushes on confesses to his best friend instead. But can you blame them? His wife's child is not his own...Tateo despairs at the thought. At that time, a man named Sumaoka happens to give him a mysterious ED drug. Tateo impulsively takes the drug and is shocked to find that the function of his lower body miraculously recovers. Tateo declares to Sumaoka that he will recreate and make this medicine himself. synonyms: [소프트 BL 단편선] 사춘기 : 너를 생각하는 봄
[Soft BL Short Story Collection] First Love Rehabilitation Log
synopsis: Hae-Jin and Ki-Hyeok met at the same taekwondo dojo when they were children. They used to be quite close, but as their respective paths in life took shape, their relationship became distant and awkward, almost as if they were strangers. In fact, ever since their days at the taekwondo dojo, Hae-Jin has always looked up to Ki-Hyeok, and finally, at the start of their freshman year of high school, the two reunite in the same school and the same class. However, Ki-Hyuk appears in such a disheveled state that he shatters Hae-Jin’s expectations. Despite this, Hae-Jin’s feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in, and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin’s inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began. (Source: KakaoPage, translated) Note: The first story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.
